text: As the world’s best low-cost airline,
AirAsia continues to provide an exceptional experience to its guests.
From discovering popular destinations to finding great deals,
AirAsia is always committed to safe journeys for every guest.
Millions of guests. Fast-growing markets.
AirAsia needed a partner that shares its commitment to safe travel,
wherever their destinations.
Most traditional insurers can’t do this.
But with over 50 local partners in more than 30 countries,
White Label and Tune Protect can close that gap.
With that reach, we built protection right into the booking journey.
So guests are covered in a few taps.
No long forms. No fine print.
From embedded protection,
to standalone options,
we curated a range that goes beyond travel protection to travel-related services,
tailored to each guest’s persona.
Simple and easy to understand,
and protected in one simple click.
Not only do we make it easy to purchase,
we make it easy to understand, with easy-to-read policies.
When a flight is delayed, guests don’t have to chase a claim.
We spot the delay and notify them first.
One tap to claim,
and approved payouts reach their bank account within three working days.
It doesn’t stop there.
If the delay reaches two hours,
registered guests get a lounge access QR code straight to their phone.
With more than 1,500 lounges worldwide,
the Delay Lounge Pass turns a delay into delight.
The Delay Lounge Pass is just one of our travel-related services,
alongside Travel eSIM, Airport Transfer, Baggage Tracker, Fast Track and more.
Because the best trips are made of moments, not just flights.
With one API connection,
AirAsia dynamically offers both insurance and travel services,
whatever fits each guest.
Modular, plug and play.
